::: {#exm-posterior-model-probability}
#### Posterior probabilities of two models

Two models with equal prior probabilities $\p(M_1) = \p(M_2) = 0.5$
and marginal likelihoods $\p(\vy \mid M_1) = 0.02$ and $\p(\vy \mid M_2) = 0.06$
have posterior probabilities
$\p(M_1 \mid \vy) = 0.01 / (0.01 + 0.03) = 0.25$
and $\p(M_2 \mid \vy) = 0.75$.
:::
